notes: UNVERIFIED, and not because nobody looked — because the fetch discarded the answer. ISIC licenses each image separately as CC0, CC-BY or CC-BY-NC, and its API returns `isic_id`, `copyright_license` and `attribution` per image. scripts/datasets/setup_derm.js read none of them and wrote one hardcoded 'CC-BY license' line for all 30 files. Since no isic_id was stored and the local filenames are sequential (melanoma_000.jpg), these images cannot be traced back to their records: resolving this means re-running the fetch, not looking something up. Any CC-BY-NC image among them may not be used in a product that is sold, and ISIC additionally requires citing the isic_id.
